ValidationRule.description: Restricts Edit access for Renewal Opportunities
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Renewal", NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Restrict_Renewal_Opportunities ), OR( ISCHANGED( OwnerId ), ISCHANGED( StageName ), ISCHANGED( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c ), ISCHANGED( Name ), ISCHANGED( NSP_AddonType__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Renewal Specialists can modify Renewal Opportunities.
